AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION

May 16, 2012
7:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Design Review No. DR-2012-14 Location: 54057-13, 18, & 20 (Rosedale)
Assessor Parcel Numbers: 8625-002-009/010/011/013, 8625-002-026/027
Applicant: Brookfield Rosedale 66, LLC
Request for approval of a Design Review application to permit the addition of a new "European Cottage" architectural style to the existing approval for the Brookfield Homes development currently marketed at "Botanika" within Rosedale planned community. Lots with in Botanika that were previously approved to be plotted with an "American Traditional" architectural style are proposed to be substituted with the newly proposed "European Cottage" architectural style.
